Hi Jorge, list,

I agree the program takes some getting used to. I keep meaning to have more
"getting started" stuff in the online manual, but sadly it never makes it to the
top of my priority list.

Regarding your question, search the list archives for "monotonicity warning" and
you will find that your question has already been asked, and answered. To access
the archives from Distance, choose Help | Distance on the web | distance-sampling
list archives. Search is the first option on that page.

Cheers,

- Len
